description: This file defines three command structures (StartCommand, StopCommand, RestartCommand) conforming to ParsableCommand, each representing a command for starting, stopping, and restarting the 'swabble' application. Each command includes a description and an asynchronous run method that outputs a placeholder message indicating the actual implementation is pending.

classes.name: StartCommand
classes.description: Defines the 'start' command with its description and run method.

classes.name: StopCommand
classes.description: Defines the 'stop' command with its description and run method.

classes.name: RestartCommand
classes.description: Defines the 'restart' command with its description and run method.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously executes the command's primary action, currently outputting placeholder messages.
